args.title: Add YAML keys to the configuration reference
args.body:
File: docs/CONFIG.md

The configuration reference currently provides environment variable names but does not specify the corresponding YAML keys used in the configuration file. Adding a column that lists the YAML keys alongside each variable will clarify the mapping and assist users in configuring the application correctly.

args.title: Fix shutdown timeout issue during deploys
args.body:
File: src/index.ts

The current implementation sets a hard stop with a timeout of 20 seconds when shutting down. This can lead to premature termination if the HTTP server does not close in time. The proposed change will improve the shutdown procedure to ensure that running import jobs are handled properly before shutting down.

args.title: Neutralise CSV exports for descriptions starting with special characters
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

CSV exports should neutralise text values that start with '=', '+', '-', or '@', to prevent them from being treated as formulas when opened in Excel or Google Sheets. This change will ensure that descriptions do not trigger formula interpretation in spreadsheet applications.
